en: Sepia-toned image of an ornate Gothic doorway inside a historic building. The pointed arch door is richly decorated with carved stone tracery and a patterned wooden door. On either side of the doorway hang framed portraits. To the left is a wall calendar showing 'Februar 11 Montag.' The lower margin of the card bears printed German text identifying the location as the Gothic door in the town hall of Breslau.
